definitions.explanation: Polite term used to refer to another person's husband. The honorific ご makes it respectful.
Can also refer to the master of a house or the proprietor of a shop.

examples.english: What does your husband do for work?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧お⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{主人|しゅじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The owner of this shop is kind.

examples.japanese: ご{主人|しゅじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please give my regards to your husband.

examples.japanese: ご{主人|しゅじん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|こ}られます→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Will you come with your husband?

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{主人|しゅじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ。
examples.english: The proprietor of this inn is good at cooking.

examples.japanese: ご{主人|しゅじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いらっしゃらない→いらっしゃる：01295_irassharu⟧⟦とき→とき：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: I will call when your husband is home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{主人|しゅじん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦おすすめ→おすすめ：09746_osusume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I asked the owner of the izakaya for recommendations.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{老舗|しにせ}→老舗：16152_shinise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{主人|しゅじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三代目|さんだいめ}→三代目：25201_sandaime⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代|だい}→代：noentry⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}→伝統：09585_dentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}り→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{続|つづ}けて→続ける：01231_tsuzukeru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦そうだ→そうだ：10076_souda⟧。
examples.english: The owner of this long-established shop is the third generation, and I hear he continues to preserve the traditions from his grandfather's time.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{寿司屋|すしや}→寿司屋：10166_sushiya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{主人|しゅじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦そうだ→そうだ：10076_souda⟧。
examples.english: I hear the owner of that sushi restaurant goes to the market every morning to select fish.

notes:
ご{主人|しゅじん} is the polite form for referring to someone else's husband.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{主人|しゅじん}→主人：00987_shujin⟧: my husband (humble when referring to own spouse)
- ⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧: husband (neutral/formal for own husband)
- ⟦{旦那|だんな}→旦那：12330_danna⟧さん: husband (casual-polite for someone else's)
- ⟦{奥|おく}さん→奥さん：02853_okusan⟧: (someone else's) wife

USAGE NOTE: Using ⟦{主人|しゅじん}→主人：00987_shujin⟧ for one's own husband is traditional but some consider it old-fashioned. Modern alternatives include ⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧ or ⟦パートナー→パートナー：11287_paatonaa⟧.
